title: Implement a Stack class to an interface
prompt: Create `stack.js` (CommonJS) exporting a class `Stack` with: `push(x)` (returns the new size), `pop()` (returns and removes the top, or undefined if empty), `peek()` (returns the top without removing, or undefined), `size()` (number of items), and `isEmpty()` (boolean). Internally use a private array. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
